concepts.name: Complementary intersection graphs
concepts.gloss: A pair of graphs on the same family of sets, one joining two sets when their intersection size lies in a prescribed set of values and the other joining the remaining pairs, so that each is the complement of the other.

evidence.quote: gives low-degree representations of complementary intersection graphs over different fields

concepts.name: Side wire
concepts.gloss: A wire of a linear network that joins two neighbouring triples of the construction, carrying values between them in addition to the central wires and the data wires.

evidence.quote: On a side wire joining neighboring physical triples
